text.text_excerpt: This is a gem of a hotel. The price is right as well for a legit 4-star hotel. Stayed last Wed-Sun. Location was perfect since you're only a 15 minute walk from the bedlum of Bourbon St. and about a 10 min walk to the Warehouse District. Plenty of good restaurants and other really good hotel bars/restaurants immediately surrounding the hotel everywhere. A very short walk also to Canal St. where one can catch a streetcar. The staff was meh. Not overly nice but not a bunch of rude or too cool for school people either. The room was really sharp, modern, and comfortable. I've read some reviews about some King rooms being small but mine felt great. Spacious bathroom with a pretty big walk-in s...

I had a great stay. The check in and check out was easy. The staff near the door were polite and lovely. Our room was clean which is a total plus. We were able to easily adjust the temperature. The shower worked just fine and it was easy to figure out (let's be real, some hotel showers are a puzzle). We went to Monkey Board, the bar on the roof, and loved the views. I loved having an easy to access bar by our hotel. We visited the Roosevelt Hotel which has Christmas lights and that was also conveniently only two blocks away. Also close to Pythian Market, a good hall. I'd recommend staying here!

I love this place. It's location is close enough to the French quarters and Bourbon Street that you can enjoy all festivities but far enough you get peace of mind and rest. The rooms come with a stand up shower, a safe, a tablet to order room service. The hotel is very modern. The employees are very friendly and welcoming. They offer advice and tips on where to go. I would stay here again.
